sec.title: Batch 3 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 3 resolves 24 longstanding mystery recordings across two iconic dramatic canons: Orson Welles' legendary London production of ***The Black Museum*** (Scotland Yard's repository of murder relics, Towers of London / Mutual 1952 syndication) and Bartlett Robinson / John Larkin's 1949 CBS daytime courtroom run of ***Perry Mason***.

sec.title: 1. *The Black Museum* (Host: Orson Welles) — 1952 Mutual / Towers Discs Dated
sec.p: Every episode of *The Black Museum* is built around a physical homicide exhibit from Scotland Yard. ASR transcription of Orson Welles' introductory monologues directly maps each tape to the 1952 master broadcast register:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Story Title | Verified Airdate | Exhibit Object & Synopsis | |---|---|---|---| | `Black_Museum_The_Silencer_Undated.mp3` | **"The Silencer"** | **1952-04-29** | Improvised firearm silencer constructed from bicycle parts and rubber washers. | | `Black_Museum_Meatjuice_NoDate.mp3` | **"Meat Juice"** | **1952-01-22** | Bottle of Valentine's Meat Juice laced with arsenic. | | `Black_Museum_Glassshards_Unknown.mp3` | **"Glass Shards"** | **1952-03-18** | Broken window shards from a country estate burglary. | | `Black_Museum_Thetelegram.mp3` | **"The Telegram"** | **1952-02-05** | Morse-coded dispatch leading to the recovery of a Thames dock victim. | | `Black_Museum_A_Can_Of_Weed_Killer.mp3` | **"A Can of Weed Killer"** | **1952-10-21** | Sodium arsenite garden weed killer container. | | `Black_Museum_44_Thestraightrazor.mp3` | **"The Straight Razor"** | **1952-11-25** | Sheffield barber's razor retrieved from a Soho lodging room. | | `Black_Museum_Thehammerhead.mp3` | **"The Hammerhead"** | **1952-05-06** | Iron ball-peen hammer head recovered from the Regent's Canal. | | `Black_Museum_Aclawhammer.mp3` | **"The Claw Hammer"** | **1952-12-16** | Carpenter's claw hammer with forensic wood splinter match. | | `Black_Museum_Afrench_English_Dictionary.mp3` | **"A French-English Dictionary"** | **1952-03-25** | Pocket pocket lexicon containing handwritten cipher notes. | | `Black_Museum_The_22_Caliber_Pistol.mp3` | **"The .22 Caliber Pistol"** | **1952-01-15** | Premiere episode (#1) murder weapon. | | `Black_Museum_A_Letter.mp3` | **"A Letter"** | **1952-11-18** | Postmarked blackmail letter with watermarked stationary. | | `Black_Museum_The_Sheath_Knife.mp3` | **"The Sheath Knife"** | **1952-01-29** | Solingen steel hunting knife dropped in Hyde Park. |
